source.content: @isTest private class ConnectApiChatterTest { @isTest static void postFeedElement() { ConnectApi.FeedElementInput input = new ConnectApi.FeedElementInput(); ConnectApi.FeedElement el = ConnectApi.ChatterFeeds.postFeedElement('internal', input); System.assertNotEquals(null, el); } @isTest static void postFeedElementBatch() { ConnectApi.BatchInput bi = new ConnectApi.BatchInput(); List<ConnectApi.BatchInput> inputs = new List<ConnectApi.BatchInput>{bi}; List<ConnectApi.BatchResult> results = ConnectApi.ChatterFeeds.postFeedElementBatch('internal', inputs); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); } @isTest static void getComment() { ConnectApi.Comment comment = ConnectApi.ChatterFeeds.getComment('internal', '0D50000000000001'); System.assertNotEquals(null, comment); } @isTest static void updateComment() { ConnectApi.CommentInput ci = new ConnectApi.CommentInput(); ConnectApi.Comment updated = ConnectApi.ChatterFeeds.updateComment('internal', '0D50000000000001', ci); System.assertNotEquals(null, updated); } @isTest static void getReputation() { ConnectApi.Reputation rep = ConnectApi.ChatterUsers.getReputation('internal', '005-user'); System.assertNotEquals(null, rep); } @isTest static void setPhoto() { ConnectApi.BinaryInput fileUpload = new ConnectApi.BinaryInput(); ConnectApi.Photo photo = ConnectApi.ChatterUsers.setPhoto('internal', '005-user', fileUpload); System.assertNotEquals(null, photo); } }
